

{{infobox Chinese|l=Yin Fire Goat|kanji=丁未|romaji=hinoto hitsuji|onyomi=teibi|p=dīwèi|w=ting-wei|mi=tʰiŋ⁵³ weɪ̯|y=deng1 mei6|j=deng1 mei6|ci=tɛŋ mei|mc=tæŋ mei|oc-bs=tæŋ mei}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yin Fire Goat''' (丁未, ''hinoto hitsuji''; onyomi ''teibi'') is the 44th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|af|Sestigdelige siklus|ar|دورة ستينية|arz|دوره ستينيه|as|ষাঠি বছৰীয়া আৱৰ্তন|ast|Ciclu sexaxenariu|bn|ষাটবার্ষিক চক্র|ca|Cicle sexagesimal|cdo|Găng-ciĕ|cs|Kan-č’|de|60-Jahre-Zyklus|eo|Ĉina sesdekjara ciklo|es|Ciclo sexagesimal chino|eu|Hirurogeitaka urteko ziklo|fa|چرخه شصت‌تایی|fr|Cycle sexagésimal chinois|hak|Kôn-chṳ̂|hy|Վաթսունամյա շրջան|id|Ganzhi|it|Ganzhi|ja|干支|ka|სამოცეული ციკლი|ko|간지|mk|Шеесетгодишен циклус|ms|Ganzhi|nn|Sekstiårig syklus|no|Sekstiårig syklus|ru|Система гань-чжи|sh|Seksagenarni ciklus|simple|Sexagenary cycle|su|Daur séksagenari|sv|Himmelska stammar och jordiska grenar|th|แผนภูมิสวรรค์|tr|Altmışlık döngü|uk|Шістдесятирічний цикл|vi|Can Chi|wuu|干支|xmf|გან-ჩჟიშ სისტემა|za|Gancei|zh|干支|zh_classical|干支|zh_min_nan|Kan-chi|zh_yue|干支|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 44th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Fire Horse|ja|丙午}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Earth Monkey|af|Aardaap (astrologie)|cdo|Muô-sĭng|de|Erde-Affe|hak|Vú-sṳ̂n|ja|戊申|ko|무신 (간지)|vi|Mậu Thân|za|Fouhsaen|zh|戊申|zh_min_nan|Bō͘-sin|zh_yue|戊申|qid=Q904781}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''丁'' is Yin Fire, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|af|Aardtak|als|Erdzweige|az|Türk-monqol təqvimi|ca|Branques terrestres|cdo|Dê-ciĕ|de|Erdzweige|fa|شاخه‌های زمینی|fi|Maalliset oksat|fr|Branche terrestre|gan|地支|hak|Thi-chṳ̂|id|Cabang Bumi|it|Ramo terrestre|ja|十二支|ko|지지 (역법)|mk|Земски гранки|ms|Dizhi|pl|Ziemskie gałęzie|ru|Земные ветви|tr|12 hayvanlı takvim|ug|12 مۆچەل تەقۋىمى|uk|Земні гілки|za|Deihcei|zh|地支|zh_min_nan|Tē-chi|zh_yue|地支|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''未'' (Goat) is Yin Earth; together they form a Mutual Generation relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|af|Wu Xing|ar|نظرية العناصر الخمسة|bcl|Wu Xing|ca|Cinc processos (Wuxing)|cdo|Ngū-hèng|cs|Pět prvků|da|De fem faser|de|Fünf-Elemente-Lehre|el|Ου Σιν|eo|Skolo de la kvin elementoj|es|Wu Xing|et|Viie elemendi õpetus|fa|وو شینگ|fi|Viisi elementtiä|fr|Wuxing (cosmologie)|gan|五行|hak|Ńg-hàng|he|חמשת היסודות|hu|Öt elem (kínai)|hy|Ու Սին|id|Wu Xing|it|Wu Xing|ja|五行思想|ko|오행|lt|Using|mk|Пет елементи|ms|Wu Xing|nl|Wu Xing|no|De fem elementene|oc|Cinc elements (Wuxing)|pl|Wu xing|pt|Wu Xing|ro|Wu Xing|ru|У-син|simple|Five elements|sk|Učenie o piatich živloch|sl|Pet elementov (vušing)|sq|Wuxing (filozofia kineze)|sr|Пет космичких усмерења|sv|De fem elementen (wu xing)|tl|Limang elemento|tr|Beş element|uk|У-сін|vi|Ngũ hành|wuu|五行|za|Nguxhengz|zh|五行|zh_classical|陰陽五行|zh_min_nan|Ngó͘-hêng|zh_yue|五行|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

=== Events ===
* The conflict in {{ill|587|en|587|qid=Q30891|lt=587 AD}} between the {{ill|Soga clan|en|Soga clan|qid=Q909854|lt=Soga clan}} and the {{ill|Mononobe clan|en|Mononobe clan|qid=Q1755836|lt=Mononobe clan}} is known as the {{ill|Soga–Mononobe conflict|en|Soga–Mononobe conflict|qid=Q534720|lt=Teibi Rebellion}}.

==Months of Yin Fire Goat==
In a Common Era year, if the final digit is 2 or 7 (that is, when the Ten Heavenly Stems are {{ill|Mizunoe (壬)|ja|壬|lt=Mizunoe (壬)}} or {{ill|Hinoto (丁)|ja|丁|lt=Hinoto (丁)}}), then {{ill|June|en|June|qid=Q120|lt=June}} becomes the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=Month}} of Teibi. However, the term “month” here may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}} or to a seasonal month (from {{ill|Xiaoshu|en|Xiaoshu|qid=Q1190976|lt=Shōsho}} until the day before {{ill|Liqiu|en|Liqiu|qid=Q1147421|lt=Rittō}}) as applicable.

==Days of Yin Fire Goat==
=== Day Selection ===
A day of Teibi is the 15th day of {{ill|Tenitsu-shin|ja|天一天上|ja_comment=天一神|2=ja|3=天一神|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11442153}}.
